$note: Motion looks (variety plan v2, SCRIPT-FORMAT v1.6, design language v1.7). A recipe bundles how nodes enter, how the camera behaves and which scene transitions to use. /script gives every episode TWO recipes (npm run look:assign -- <nnn>): picked at random, never one used by the last 3 episodes where possible; Part 2 reuses Part 1's pair. The pair is written to the episode's look.recipes, so renders are reproducible. The engine fills any scene that doesn't set transition / enter / camera itself from the pair: recipes alternate every 2 scenes, transitions cycle through the recipe's list (never the same twice in a row), a scene that continues another (stage.reuse) stays a cut. Edit 'recipes' to add or change one (transitions: cut, push, whip, flip, stack, dive, iris).
